The purpose of this portfolio piece is to be able to simulate data. 


```{r simulate_participants}
library(dyngen)

set.seed(123)
test_age <- rnorm_bounded(96, mean = 18.68, sd=0.827, min = 18, max = 22)

# add race variable
race_categories <- c("White", "Black or African American", "Asian", "Multiracial")
race_observations <- c(71, 9, 10, 6)
race_total_observations <- sum(race_observations)
race_vector <- rep(race_categories, race_observations)
simulated_race_data <- sample(race_vector, size = race_total_observations, replace = FALSE)

# add gender variable 

gender_categories <- c("female", "male")
gender_observations <- c(74, 22)
gender_total_observations <- sum(gender_observations)
gender_vector <- rep(gender_categories, gender_observations)
simulated_gender_data <- sample (gender_vector, size = gender_total_observations, replace = FALSE)

# add year in college variable 
college_year_categories <- c("First-year", "Sophomore", "Junior", "Senior")
college_year_observations <- c(62, 28, 4, 2)
college_year_total_observations <- sum(college_year_observations)
college_year_vector <- rep(college_year_categories, college_year_observations)
simulated_college_year_data <- sample (college_year_vector, size = college_year_total_observations, replace = FALSE)

# add Bias, Accuracy, Maintenance
```
